description: This file implements a bot that uses vision and text-to-speech services, manages a pipeline, and handles client connection events to describe images using a vision model and generate speech output.

classes.name: UserImageRawFrame
classes.description: Represents a raw image frame with image data, format, size, and associated text.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Handles the sequence of processing steps including vision, TTS, and transport output.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with parameters and manages its execution.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for a pipeline, such as metrics and usage tracking.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution of a pipeline, including handling signals and cancellation.

classes.name: RunnerArguments
classes.description: Contains arguments and configuration for running the bot, including transport settings and body content.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Abstract class for transport mechanisms handling client communication.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot pipeline, handling client connection events to process images.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point that initializes transport and starts the bot.
